id: \rI can never stop a trainer from getting to Ramos.
en: \rI can never stop a trainer from getting to Ramos.
it: \rNon riesco mai a impedire a un Allenatore di arrivare da Amur.

id: \bRamos: Welcome to my gym. I hope you enjoyed the nature as you came here. There won't be any time to look now that you've come to me.
en: \bRamos: Welcome to my gym. I hope you enjoyed the nature as you came here. There won't be any time to look now that you've come to me.
it: \bRamos: Benvenuto nella mia Palestra. Spero che tu abbia apprezzato la natura venendo qui. Ora che sei arrivato da me, non ci sarà più tempo per guardarsi intorno.

id: \bTM116 contains Petal Dance. It attacks for multiple turns and leaves you confused.
en: \bTM116 contains Petal Dance. It attacks for multiple turns and leaves you confused.
it: \bLa MT116 contiene Petalodanza. Attacca per più turni e poi lascia confuso chi la usa.

id: \bRamos: You have the quickness of youth but the skill of a master. Be sure to remember to take it slow sometimes.
en: \bRamos: You have the quickness of youth but the skill of a master. Be sure to remember to take it slow sometimes.
it: \bRamos: Hai la rapidità della gioventù, ma l'abilità di un maestro. Ricordati però di prendertela con calma, ogni tanto.

id: \rAnd out of nowhere comes a champion.
en: \rAnd out of nowhere comes a champion.

id: \rI was supposed to be the champion. I was going to challenge Ramos after this...
en: \rI was supposed to be the champion. I was going to challenge Ramos after this...
it: \rIl campione dovevo essere io. Dopo questa avrei sfidato Amur...

id: \bRamos uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
en: \bRamos uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
it: \bRamos usa Pokémon di tipo Erba. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Fuoco, Veleno, Volante e Ghiaccio.

id: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock. Electric, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock.  Electric, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Acqua, Terra e Roccia.  Anche le mosse di tipo Elettro, Erba, Terra e Acqua non fanno molti danni.

id: \bDon't rush. You may miss the path you want to take.
en: \bDon't rush. You may miss the path you want to take.
it: \bNon avere fretta. Potresti perdere la strada che vuoi seguire.
